translations.web: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
translations.bsb: O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
translations.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
translations.asv: O ye simple, understand prudence; And, ye fools, be of an understanding heart.
